verses.en: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
verses.pt: Chamou, pois, Moisés a todo o Israel, e disse-lhes: Ouve, ó Israel, os estatutos e preceitos que hoje vos falo aos ouvidos, para que os aprendais e cuideis em os cumprir.
verses.en_web: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses sent for all Israel, and said to them, Give ear, O Israel, to the laws and the decisions which I give you today, and give attention to them so that you may keep and do them.

verses.en: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.pt: O Senhor nosso Deus fez um pacto conosco em Horebe.
verses.en_web: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord our God made an agreement with us in Horeb.

verses.en: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
verses.pt: Não com nossos pais fez o Senhor esse pacto, mas conosco, sim, com todos nós que hoje estamos aqui vivos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord did not make this agreement with our fathers but with us, who are all living and present here today.

verses.en: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
verses.pt: Face a face falou o Senhor conosco no monte, do meio o fogo
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord came to you face to face on the mountain, out of the heart of the fire,

verses.en: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
verses.pt: (estava eu nesse tempo entre o Senhor e vós, para vos anunciar a palavra do Senhor; porque tivestes medo por causa do fogo, e não subistes ao monte) , dizendo ele:
verses.en_web: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word: for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain;) saying,
verses.en_bbe: (I was between the Lord and you at that time, to make clear to you the word of the Lord: because, through fear of the fire, you did not go up the mountain;) saying,

verses.en: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.pt: Eu sou o Senhor teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão.
verses.en_web: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.en_bbe: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.

verses.en: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
verses.pt: Não terás outros deuses diante de mim.
verses.en_web: “You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.en_bbe: You are to have no other gods but me.

verses.en: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.pt: Não farás para ti imagem esculpida, nem figura alguma do que há em cima no céu, nem embaixo na terra, nem nas águas debaixo da terra;
verses.en_web: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself, any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
verses.en_bbe: You may not make for yourselves an image in the form of anything in heaven or on earth or in the waters under the earth:

verses.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
verses.pt: não te encurvarás diante delas, nem as servirás; porque eu, o Senhor teu Deus, sou Deus zeloso, que visito a iniqüidade dos pais nos filhos até a terceira e quarta geração daqueles que me odeiam,
verses.en_web: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them; for I, Yahweh, your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me;
verses.en_bbe: You may not go down on your faces before them or give them worship: for I, the Lord your God, am a God who will not give his honour to another; and I will send punishment on the children for the wrongdoing of their fathers, to the third and fourth generation of my haters;

verses.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.pt: e uso de misericórdia com milhares dos que me amam e guardam os meus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.en_bbe: And I will have mercy through a thousand generations on those who have love for me and keep my laws.

verses.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.pt: Não tomarás o nome do Senhor teu Deus em vão; porque o Senhor não terá por inocente aquele que tomar o seu nome em vão.
verses.en_web: “You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain: for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
verses.en_bbe: You are not to make use of the name of the Lord your God for an evil purpose; whoever takes the Lord's name on his lips for an evil purpose will be judged as a sinner by the Lord.

verses.en: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
verses.pt: Guarda o dia do sábado, para o santificar, como te ordenou o senhor teu Deus;
verses.en_web: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God commanded you.
verses.en_bbe: Keep the Sabbath day as a holy day, as you have been ordered by the Lord your God.

verses.en: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
verses.pt: seis dias trabalharás, e farás todo o teu trabalho;
verses.en_web: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;
verses.en_bbe: On six days do all your work:

verses.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
verses.pt: mas o sétimo dia é o sábado do Senhor teu Deus; nesse dia não farás trabalho algum, nem tu, nem teu filho, nem tua filha, nem o teu servo, nem a tua serva, nem o teu boi, nem o teu jumento, nem animal algum teu, nem o estrangeiro que está dentro das tuas portas; para que o teu servo e a tua serva descansem assim como tu.
verses.en_web: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
verses.en_bbe: But the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God; on that day do no work, you or your son or your daughter, or your man-servant or your woman-servant, or your ox or your ass or any of your cattle, or the man from a strange country who is living among you; so that your man-servant and your woman-servant may have rest as well as you.

verses.en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.pt: Lembra-te de que foste servo na terra do Egito, e que o Senhor teu Deus te tirou dali com mão forte e braço estendido; pelo que o Senhor teu Deus te ordenou que guardasses o dia do sábado.
verses.en_web: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore Yahweh your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
verses.en_bbe: And keep in mind that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord your God took you out of that land by his strong hand and his stretched-out arm: for this reason the Lord has given you orders to keep the Sabbath day.

verses.en: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.pt: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe, como o senhor teu Deus te ordenou, para que se prolonguem os teus dias, e para que te vá bem na terra que o Senhor teu Deus te dá.
verses.en_web: “Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you; that your days may be long, and that it may go well with you, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
verses.en_bbe: Give honour to your father and your mother, as you have been ordered by the Lord your God; so that your life may be long and all may be well for you in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.en: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.pt: Não matarás.
verses.en_web: “You shall not murder.
verses.en_bbe: Do not put anyone to death without cause.

verses.en: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
verses.pt: Não adulterarás.
verses.en_web: “You shall not commit adultery.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be false to the married relation.

verses.en: Neither shalt thou steal.
verses.pt: Não furtarás.
verses.en_web: “You shall not steal.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take the property of another.

verses.en: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.pt: Não dirás falso testemunho contra o teu próximo.
verses.en_web: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give false witness against your neighbour;

verses.en: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour’s.
verses.pt: Não cobiçarás a mulher do teu próximo; não desejarás a casa do teu próximo; nem o seu campo, nem o seu servo, nem a sua serva, nem o seu boi, nem o seu jumento, nem coisa alguma do teu próximo.
verses.en_web: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”
verses.en_bbe: Or let your desire be turned to your neighbour's wife, or his house or his field or his man-servant or his woman-servant or his ox or his ass or anything which is your neighbour's.

verses.en: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
verses.pt: Essas palavras falou o senhor a toda a vossa assembléia no monte, do meio do fogo, da nuvem e da escuridão, com grande voz; e nada acrescentou. E escreveu-as em duas tábuas de pedra, que ele me deu.
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
verses.en_bbe: These words the Lord said to all of you together on the mountain, out of the heart of the fire, out of the cloud and the dark, with a great voice: and he said no more; he put them in writing on the two stones of the law and gave them to me.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.pt: Mas quando ouvistes a voz do meio das trevas, enquanto ardia o monte em fogo, viestes ter comigo, mesmo todos os cabeças das vossas tribos, e vossos anciãos,
verses.en_web: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.en_bbe: And after hearing the voice which came out of the dark while the mountain was burning with fire, all the heads of your tribes and your chiefs came to me,

verses.en: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
verses.pt: e dissestes: Eis que o Senhor nosso Deus nos fez ver a sua glória e a sua grandeza, e ouvimos a sua voz do meio do fogo; hoje vimos que Deus fala com o homem, e este ainda continua vivo.
verses.en_web: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
verses.en_bbe: And said, The Lord has let us see his glory and his power, and his voice has come to us out of the fire: today we have seen that a man may go on living even after hearing the voice of God.

verses.en: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, por que havemos de morrer? Este grande fogo nos consumirá; se ainda mais ouvirmos a voz do Senhor nosso Deus, morreremos.
verses.en_web: Now therefore why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
verses.en_bbe: Why then is death to be our fate? For if the voice of the Lord our God comes to us any more, death will overtake us, and we will be burned up in this great fire.

verses.en: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.pt: Porque, quem há de toda a carne, que tenha ouvido a voz do Deus vivente a falar do meio do fogo, como nós a ouvimos, e ainda continue vivo?
verses.en_web: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.en_bbe: For what man is there in all the earth, who, hearing the voice of the living God as we have, out of the heart of the fire, has been kept from death?

verses.en: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
verses.pt: Chega-te tu, e ouve tudo o que o Senhor nosso Deus falar; e tu nos dirás tudo o que ele te disser; assim o ouviremos e o cumpriremos.
verses.en_web: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
verses.en_bbe: Do you go near: and after hearing everything which the Lord our God has to say, give us an account of all he has said to you, and we will give ear, and do it.

verses.en: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.pt: Ouvindo, pois, o Senhor as vossas palavras, quando me faláveis, disse-me: Eu ouvi as palavras deste povo, que eles te disseram; falaram bem em tudo quanto disseram.
verses.en_web: Yahweh heard the voice of your words, when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord, hearing your words to me, said to me, The words which this people have said to you have come to my ears: what they have said is well said.

verses.en: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.pt: Quem dera que eles tivessem tal coração que me temessem, e guardassem em todo o tempo todos os meus mandamentos, para que bem lhes fosse a eles, e a seus filhos para sempre!
verses.en_web: Oh that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children forever!
verses.en_bbe: If only they had such a heart in them at all times, so that they might go in fear of me and keep my orders and that it might be well for them and for their children for ever!

verses.en: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
verses.pt: Vai, dize-lhes: Voltai às vossas tendas.
verses.en_web: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
verses.en_bbe: Now say to them, Go back to your tents.

verses.en: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
verses.pt: Tu, porém, deixa-te ficar aqui comigo, e eu te direi todos os mandamentos, estatutos e preceitos que tu lhes hás de ensinar, para que eles os cumpram na terra que eu lhes dou para a possuírem.
verses.en_web: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.”
verses.en_bbe: But as for you, keep your place here by me, and I will give you all the orders and the laws and the decisions which you are to make clear to them, so that they may do them in the land which I am giving them for their heritage.

verses.en: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.pt: Olhai, pois, que façais como vos ordenou o Senhor vosso Deus; não vos desviareis nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.
verses.en_web: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
verses.en_bbe: Take care, then, to do whatever the Lord your God has given you orders to do; let there be no turning away to the right hand or to the left.

verses.en: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
verses.pt: Andareis em todo o caminho que vos ordenou a Senhor vosso Deus, para que vivais e bem vos suceda, e prolongueis os vossos dias na terra que haveis de possuir.
verses.en_web: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
verses.en_bbe: Go on walking in the way ordered for you by the Lord your God, so that life may be yours and it may be well for you, and your days may be long in the land of your heritage.
